title: Web: battery and example
goal: A library author starts a full-stack web app from one first-party battery package and one executable example that proves routes, forms, data, auth, live reload, and both build targets on every execution tier.
criteria: The web battery package builds and its example runs green on default jet run, --release, jet build, and the web target, with goldens
The example exercises list, create, detail, login, protected route, static asset, and dev watcher restart with state retention observed

title: Games: battery and example
goal: A 2-D game skeleton with a fixed-step loop, input, sprites, audio, scene graph, save file, and a 600-frame deterministic replay, from one battery package and one example.
criteria: The games battery package and example run green on default jet run, --release, and jet build with a 600-frame replay hash golden
Keyboard and gamepad input, atlas sprite drawing, and one-shot plus streamed audio are exercised headless

title: CLI and scripts: battery and example
goal: A typed CLI tool with subcommands, ignore-aware search, process pipelines, typed record flow, jobs, script mode, and a release install, from one battery package and one example.
criteria: The CLI battery package and example run green on every execution tier with goldens
A producer feeding an arbitrary child through stdin and EOF completes without a timeout

title: Data analysis: battery and example
goal: CSV and Parquet into the core table, group/join/pivot/window, a typed regression, a labeled array, SVG and PNG plots, a notebook cell graph, and a receipt, from one battery package and one example, timed against pandas and polars.
criteria: The data battery package and example run green on every execution tier including default-tier joins, with goldens
Parquet read and PNG export work through first-party packages and the timing harness records pandas and polars on the same input

title: Backend services: battery and example
goal: A JSON API with typed contracts and OpenAPI export, a bounded database pool, a durable queue, auth, structured logs, request deadlines, SIGTERM drain, and a 1000-user load test, from one battery package and one example.
criteria: The backend battery package and example run green on every execution tier including a native release build, with goldens
A request deadline cancels an in-flight handler and SIGTERM drains the server within the bounded grace period

title: AI and ML applications: battery and example
goal: Tensors, a two-layer network trained with compute.gradient, a typed loader, checkpoints, an embedding index, a streaming LLM tool loop, and a GPU placement receipt, from one battery package and one example, timed against NumPy and PyTorch.
criteria: The AI battery package and example run green on every execution tier with compute.gradient working in the default tier and in native code
A 10,000-entry embedding index checks and builds inside the build budget and the timing harness records NumPy and PyTorch

title: GUI applications: battery and example
goal: A desktop notes app with an editor, shortcuts, dialogs, clipboard, IME, undo, themes, accessibility names, and packaging, from one battery package and one example, on headless, TUI, and native hosts.
criteria: The GUI battery package and example run green headless and on the native host on every execution tier, with goldens
Clipboard, IME composition, file dialogs, shortcuts, and accessible names are exercised on the native host and stubbed deterministically headless

title: Embedded: battery and example
goal: Cortex-M firmware with typed registers, a bounded interrupt handoff, a DMA-owned buffer, a UART ring, a deadline-checked loop, a signed A/B slot, and a flash receipt, from one battery package and one example that also replays on the host.
criteria: The embedded battery package and example build for board.sensor_v1 and replay green on the host on every execution tier, with goldens
Interrupt binding, DMA ownership, typed register blocks, and the flash receipt are exercised on a board or an emulator

title: Primitives the probes found missing
goal: Every primitive ballot in the foundations slate is decided by the owner and, once ratified, implemented across parser, sema, TIR, native, JIT, interpreter, and web with examples, goldens, and diagnostics.
criteria: Every D-FOUND-* ballot is ratified or rejected by the owner and its card reflects the ruling
Each ratified primitive ships with an executable example, goldens on every execution tier, registered diagnostics with snapshots, and Syntax.rs entries where syntax was added

title: Probe programs as executable examples
goal: Each primitive probe program that already works lands as an executable example with goldens, so the buildable niches stay proven on every execution tier.
criteria: Every probe example card has its program under examples/ with goldens on every applicable execution tier
No example is parked as AOT-only or in tests/jit_gaps.txt
